why_ai: Families pay for in-person teaching, supervision of minors and a school community.
why_clarity: Teaching quality is contested and outcomes show up years later in student lives.
why_digital: Children taught in classrooms on a local campus that families choose in person.

why_ai: Longitudinal norms on tens of millions of students protect them, though test content is generatable.
why_clarity: Psychometric methods are codified and scores are calibrated each testing window.
why_digital: Online adaptive tests in, score and growth reports out.

why_ai: Value lies in a trusted standardized score comparable across applicants, which AI cheating threatens.
why_clarity: Item calibration and scaled scoring follow established psychometric procedure.
why_digital: Items and responses are digital, with proctored administration at test sites or online.

why_ai: Authorizing schools and moderating exams confers a programme brand that schools buy for differentiation.
why_clarity: Frameworks and authorization criteria are written, but programme quality judgments vary by reviewer.
why_digital: Frameworks are documents, while authorization visits and teacher training happen in person.

why_ai: Closure and consolidation decisions are high-stakes community judgments, though the monitoring is routine.
why_clarity: Enrolment and finance tracking repeats each cycle, but viability calls resolve over years.
why_digital: Enrolment and financial records analysed centrally with no commercial market.

why_ai: Capacity and propensity scoring from assembled wealth data is a modelling task.
why_clarity: Scores are checked against observed giving across the client base.
why_digital: Wealth indicator data in, scores and prospect profiles out.

why_ai: Families pay for one consultant's personal, undocumented knowledge of schools and children.
why_clarity: Each child and family is different and fit is a matter of judgment.
why_digital: Meetings with families and school visits, found through local word of mouth.

why_ai: Cross-school yield evidence and adviser credibility matter, but pricing models are automatable.
why_clarity: Net tuition revenue measures success, though each school's market differs.
why_digital: Pricing and enrolment data in, models and strategy out, mostly remote.

why_ai: Expected contribution is a formula over household financial data that software computes.
why_clarity: Need methodology is codified and applied to hundreds of thousands of families.
why_digital: Online financial submissions in, contribution calculations out.

why_ai: Affluent families pay $20K-$50K for in-person teaching, community culture and programmes.
why_clarity: Academic outcomes are partly measurable, but culture and fit are judged subjectively.
why_digital: In-person classrooms and campus life, chosen through visits and local reputation.

why_ai: Benchmark compilation is routine; member-contributed data is the only protection.
why_clarity: The same tuition, salary and enrolment tables are produced every year.
why_digital: Contributed data in, online benchmarks and comparison tools out.

why_ai: SEVIS and I-20 work is deterministic, but a designated school official remains accountable.
why_clarity: Immigration documents and transcript rules give defined, checkable steps.
why_digital: Applications from abroad handled remotely, with some recruitment travel.

why_ai: Specialists deliver individualized in-person instruction and therapy to vulnerable children.
why_clarity: Goal frameworks exist, but each child's plan and progress differ.
why_digital: Hands-on instruction and therapy in classrooms families visit.

why_ai: Guides work hands-on with young children in multi-age classrooms using physical materials.
why_clarity: Narrative, competency-based assessment has no grades and no fixed success measure.
why_digital: Physical materials, paper observation records and in-person classrooms.

why_ai: Faith community schools teach children in person, answerable to pastor and diocese.
why_clarity: Diocesan processes are standardized, but educational outcomes resolve slowly.
why_digital: In-person teaching within a local parish community.

why_ai: Accreditation confers standing and sometimes legal operation, decided by visiting teams.
why_clarity: Standards are written, but school quality is judged by peer visitors over multi-year cycles.
why_digital: Self-studies are documents, while visiting teams evaluate schools on site.

why_ai: Narratives follow a fixed structure drafted from academic and behavioral data, which LLMs do well.
why_clarity: Strengths, growth areas and recommendations recur for every student each term.
why_digital: Grade and observation data in, written narratives out in the SIS.

why_ai: Boards raise money on planners' credibility and decade-long space and enrolment judgments.
why_clarity: Each campus plan is bespoke and its projections are tested a decade later.
why_digital: Campus surveys on site feed digital plans and studies for regional clients.

why_ai: In-product analytics on funnel data is software work AI tools readily extend.
why_clarity: Funnel and attrition analytics are defined reports checked each admission cycle.
why_digital: Enrolment and giving records in, software reporting out.

why_ai: Insurers carry withdrawal risk on their balance sheet, which AI does not replace.
why_clarity: Withdrawal claims recur annually and price annual contracts within a year.
why_digital: Withdrawal data in, ratings and plan design out.

why_ai: Small community schools where a few teachers and one administrator serve local families in person.
why_clarity: The administrator improvises across every role with no standard measure of success.
why_digital: Paper records and in-person teaching in a small, local community.

why_ai: Billing, discounts, aid awards and payment plans are rule-based, high-volume back-office work.
why_clarity: Each family's bill follows defined rules and either reconciles or does not.
why_digital: Billing and aid data processed entirely in software.
